items.title: Pay dog school invoice
items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 21.11.2026, a Saturday. This is a private-law payment term under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026. Adding 14 days per § 188 Abs. 1 BGB lands on 05.12.2026, which is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB a deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday moves to the next business day, which is Monday 07.12.2026. No NW public holiday falls in this window.

warnings: This is an ordinary company invoice with no legal-remedy notice (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung); 'remedy_type' is set to 'none'.

The printed IBAN (DE10 3705 0198 0005 5491 20) is well-formed and matches the sender's own letterhead, but the account holder cannot be verified from the letter alone — confirm it matches prior invoices from this dog school before paying.
Allow about one business day for the bank transfer to arrive (§ 675s BGB); sending the payment by Friday 04.12.2026 should ensure it reaches the school by the 07.12.2026 due date.
